projects.title: NYU Re/presenting Data: urban data visualization contest
projects.description: NYU Data Services ran an urban data visualization contest with 30+ submissions, exhibited at 370 Jay Street on April 9, 2026.
projects.why_interesting: A fresh crop of student and researcher urban data visualizations, all built with NYC-area data, just went on display this week.

projects.title: OSCUR: open-source cyberinfrastructure for urban computing research
projects.description: Multi-institutional platform funded by a $5M NSF grant to build an open-source ecosystem of tools for transforming city data into actionable knowledge.
projects.why_interesting: Major federal investment in open tooling for urban data analysis, led by UIC with partners across institutions.

projects.title: CityPulse: urban mobility risk intelligence platform
projects.description: Platform combining H3 geospatial indexing, ML demand/risk scoring, LLM natural language analytics, and an MCP server for urban mobility data.
projects.why_interesting: Interesting blend of cutting-edge tech (H3, LLMs, MCP protocol) applied specifically to urban mobility risk assessment.

projects.title: Toronto shelter opioid risk mapping
projects.description: Geospatial analysis creating epidemiological profiles of opioid poisoning risk around homeless shelters in Toronto, built in R.
projects.why_interesting: Directly policy-relevant spatial analysis connecting shelter locations to overdose risk, with clear public health implications.

projects.title: Urban heat island classification from satellite imagery
projects.description: ML pipeline to classify urban heat island intensity using satellite imagery, built for the EY AI and Analytics Challenge.
projects.why_interesting: Practical ML approach to a growing urban climate problem, classifying heat island severity directly from satellite data.

projects.title: NYC 311 + weather data warehouse in dbt and DuckDB
projects.description: Dimensional data warehouse built with dbt and DuckDB, joining NYC 311 service requests with Open-Meteo weather data.
projects.why_interesting: Clean modern data stack approach to an evergreen NYC question: how does weather affect 311 complaints?
